text:
amelia: Hey team — NebulaHealth just pinged support: their dashboard shows ~1.10M tokens on 2024-06-12 but the compact CSV export and the invoice both show ~820k. Customer says ~280k tokens are missing for tenant nebula-prod. Can we triage?

samir: Thanks Amelia. Do we have the compact export job id / manifest path?

amelia: Job id export-98765, manifest at s3://redwood-exports/compact/2024-06-12/manifest.json. Customer attached the CSV they downloaded (small file). I pulled the manifest and noticed a few lines reference s3://redwood-exports-old/compact/2024-06-12/shard-7.csv.gz which doesn't exist in the new bucket.

support-bot: export-run export-98765 completed status=success uploaded_manifest=s3://redwood-exports/compact/2024-06-12/manifest.json checksum=8a7f...

samir: Can you paste the top of the manifest?

amelia: Copied snippet:```json
[
  "s3://redwood-exports/compact/2024-06-12/shard-0.csv.gz",
  "s3://redwood-exports/compact/2024-06-12/shard-1.csv.gz",
  "s3://redwood-exports-old/compact/2024-06-12/shard-7.csv.gz",
  "s3://redwood-exports/compact/2024-06-12/shard-8.csv.gz"
]
```

ralph: That mismatch is suspicious — we migrated compact exports to the new bucket two months ago. If the manifest references the old bucket and the compact assembler silently skips missing shard keys, that would drop rows and undercount tokens.

ingest-oncall: I looked at assembler logs around run export-98765:```
2024-06-13T02:10:12Z INFO assembler: loading manifest s3://redwood-exports/compact/2024-06-12/manifest.json
2024-06-13T02:10:13Z WARN assembler: missing shard s3://redwood-exports-old/compact/2024-06-12/shard-7.csv.gz, skipping count_estimate=276543
2024-06-13T02:10:13Z INFO assembler: assembled shards=11 skipped=1 tokens_approx=823981
```

samir: That log explains the ~276k gap. Why did the manifest include old keys? Which service produces manifest?

ingest-oncall: The export manifest is produced by compact-batcher (batcher v2). We rolled a flag last week to point batcher v2 at the new bucket but there was a race for late-sharded uploads — some workers still wrote to redwood-exports-old because their env var didn't refresh during a rolling deploy. The batcher collects uploaded shard paths at commit time; if a worker uploaded to the old bucket, manifest contains that path. The assembler doesn't re-map old -> new.

billing-ops: Customer-facing impact: invoices were generated from compact export pipeline. If compact was assembled with skipped shards the invoice token counts will be low. We need to either backfill assembled CSVs for 2024-06-12 for nebula-prod or regenerate invoice for that billing window.

samir: Repro steps for ops: 1) fetch manifest 2) attempt to fetch all keys 3) log missing keys and their estimated token counts. We have the estimate in assembler logs. Can you run a dry run to confirm counts?

ingest-oncall: Running now. Command used: `./compact-assembler --manifest s3://redwood-exports/compact/2024-06-12/manifest.json --dry-run --report-missing`

support-bot: dry-run complete. missing_keys=1 estimated_missing_tokens=276543

ralph: Plan: 1) rehydrate any missing objects from the old bucket (if in Glacier) or copy from archive; 2) re-run assembler for 2024-06-12 into a new compact export (backfill job backfill-213456); 3) run billing reconciliation and regenerate invoice if needed. Who owns each step?

billing-ops: Billing will validate once assembled CSVs are back. If token delta > 10k we'll issue invoice adjustment and notify NebulaHealth.

ingest-oncall: I can own copy/rehydrate + assembler run. Initial ETA: rehydrate checks in 30m, copy complete in ~2h if not archived. If it's archived we'll open a glacier restore which can be ~12h. I'll update thread.

amelia: I'll message the customer with an interim status: "We found a missing shard referenced by our manifest that caused an undercount. We're running a backfill and will update you with ETA; we may issue an invoice correction." :eyes:

support-bot: reminder: follow-up in 24h if no progress.

samir: Thanks all. Keep updates concise here. Once assembler succeeds, attach backfill job id and a diff summary for nebula-prod (tokens_before, tokens_after, rows_added). :thumbsup:
